Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Restores the supplied title-and-artist card design at a restrained 70% in-game scale.
- Adds 0.7 yalms of world-space clearance above player nameplates.
- Refreshes changed tracks immediately and prevents album covers from remaining stuck after transient loading failures.
